_comment: Words in the user's request that decide how much of the authoring context a chat AI needs (npdev ai context --detail auto, npdev_ai.suggest_detail). Facts only; matched case-insensitively as whole words or word starts. A request with a `full` word gets full, else with a `standard` word gets standard, else lean. When unsure the answer is standard: lean is only for a request that is clearly just records to keep. English and Portuguese, because the ask is written in the owner's language. Measured 2026-11-17 (Build/ai-bench/lvl-*): lean passes simple-crud at ~2.4k tokens per app and needs 3 repairs on a role/lifecycle app.
